must_identify.text: The four detections are presented as one attack chain, not four unrelated alerts, ordered oldest to newest: failed-auth burst, burst-then-success, lateral logon to the DC, directory replication.
The chain escalates in scope and severity from the workstation talondellbox to the domain controller talondc01 (levels 12 to 15).
Detection 100220 (DRSUAPI replication from a non-DC host) is identified as a DCSync-class credential theft attempt and is treated as the most critical item, not a routine event.
The new talondellbox:3389/tcp exposure from the recon delta is connected to the chain as corroborating attack surface, not reported in isolation.

Options include isolating talondellbox, obtaining the account from the raw alerts (TargetUserName) before resetting it, hunting talondc01 for replication abuse or krbtgt changes, and closing the new RDP exposure.

High confidence is stated for the chain and justified by two independent sources (the time-ordered alert chain across two hosts and the recon delta), while the missing account and source address are named as data requests rather than used to hedge the chain.
